regions.today: Generally dry and mostly cloudy this afternoon and evening, perhaps just a few spots of drizzle in the north of Leinster, in moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Staying dry and mostly cloudy tonight. Lowest temperatures of 14 or 15 degrees, with moderate westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Generally cloudy but dry again tomorrow with sunny spells developing later and becoming mostly sunny in the south of Leinster. Highest temperatures of 18 to 21 degrees, with moderate westerly winds.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate under cloud; High in any sunshine.
